note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after d8e084c3eb). Section 3: "Protected resources supporting metadata MUST make a JSON document containing metadata as specified in Section 2 available at a URL formed by inserting a well-known URI string into the protected resource's resource identifier between the host component and the path and/or query components, if any." Path clause: TestRFC9728WellKnownInsertedBetweenHostAndPath serves the document through ServeHTTP at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp with resource https://mcp.example/mcp, advertises the same URL, and answers 404 at the suffix after the path and at the bare suffix. Query clause: TestRFC9728WellKnownInsertedBeforeQuery covers /mcp?tenant=a and the query-only identifier, and refuses the dropped query, suffix after path, bare suffix and suffix after query. The weak finding rested on the producer defect for https://mcp.example/mcp/, fixed in resourceOriginAndPath; that input is pinned at resourceMetadataURL and resourceMetadataPath by the RFC9728-3.1-3 units, not by this row's own units.
upgrade_reason: No tagged unit of this row changed. The earlier weak verdict rested on resourceOriginAndPath trimming the path's own trailing slash, a producer defect for one input that d8e084c3eb fixed (only a lone "/" path is dropped now). Re-read both tagged units at their bodies: they serve and refuse through ServeHTTP for the path, query and query-only identifiers, so a construction that appended, dropped or misplaced the suffix goes red. The trailing-slash input that this row's units do not carry is asserted, URL and served path, by TestRFC9728TerminatingSlashRemovedBeforeInsertion under RFC9728-3.1-3.
